description: This file defines the CameraCaptureManager class, which manages camera device enumeration, permissions, capturing photos, and recording videos or clips using Android's CameraX library and related APIs. It encapsulates camera device information, handles permissions, and provides methods for taking snapshots and recording clips with configurable parameters.

classes.name: CameraCaptureManager
classes.description: Manages camera device enumeration, permission handling, image capture, and video recording with configurable parameters. Provides methods to list available devices, take snapshots, and record video clips with options for quality, device selection, and permission requests.

classes.name: Payload
classes.description: Data class representing the JSON payload of a captured image, including its format, base64-encoded data, width, and height.

classes.name: FilePayload
classes.description: Data class representing a recorded video clip, including the output file, duration, and whether it includes audio.

classes.name: CameraDeviceInfo
classes.description: Data class describing camera device properties such as id, name, position, and device type.

methods.name: attachLifecycleOwner
methods.description: Attaches a lifecycle owner to the camera manager to control camera lifecycle.

methods.name: attachPermissionRequester
methods.description: Attaches a permission requester to handle runtime permission requests.

methods.name: listDevices
methods.description: Lists available camera devices sorted by ID.

methods.name: snap
methods.description: Captures a photo with configurable parameters like device orientation, quality, max width, and device id. Returns a Payload with photo data encoded in Base64.

methods.name: clip
methods.description: Records a video clip with configurable parameters such as duration, device orientation, and audio inclusion. Returns a FilePayload with the output file.

methods.name: rotateBitmapByExif
methods.description: Rotates the bitmap based on EXIF orientation data.

methods.name: parseFacing
methods.description: Parses the camera facing direction ('front' or 'back') from JSON parameters.

methods.name: parseMaxWidth
methods.description: Parses maximum width parameter from JSON.

methods.name: parseDurationMs
methods.description: Parses duration in milliseconds from JSON.

methods.name: parseIncludeAudio
methods.description: Parses includeAudio boolean flag from JSON parameters.

methods.name: resolveCameraSelector
methods.description: Resolves the CameraSelector based on device ID and facing parameters.

methods.name: cameraDeviceInfoOrNull
methods.description: Extracts camera device info from CameraInfo object, including ID, position, and device type.

methods.name: cameraIdOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves the camera ID string from CameraInfo.

methods.name: takeJpegWithExif
methods.description: Captures a JPEG image and reads its EXIF orientation.
